title: Converting non-ndarray array-likes before cross-namespace array API transfer
answers: Why do classification metrics fail when given pandas Series and array API predictions?
How to support pandas Series or list inputs when dispatching to array API devices in move_to?
TypeError or failure when using pandas labels with PyTorch or CuPy predictions under array_api_dispatch
How are non-ndarray array-like inputs transferred across namespaces in sklearn/utils/_array_api.py:move_to?
body:
Symptom: Classification metrics fail when passed pandas Series labels alongside predictions from a different array API namespace or device with array API dispatch enabled.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/_array_api.py:move_to passed non-ndarray array-like containers directly to DLPack cross-namespace transfer without converting them to ndarrays first.
Fix pattern: Convert non-ndarray containers belonging to the NumPy namespace into numpy.ndarray using numpy.asarray before initiating DLPack transfer to another namespace.
Constraints: Applies only when moving from the NumPy namespace (_is_numpy_namespace(xp_array)) to a non-NumPy namespace (not _is_numpy_namespace(xp)) when the object is not already an instance of numpy.ndarray.
applies: Cross-namespace array API dispatch when mixing array-like containers (e.g. pandas Series) with non-NumPy array devices or namespaces.
